memo: New base + our new component. Base: saddamaditya/0-451-sota-forensics-lab-apex-synthesis v1 (public LB 0.451 as titled, Apache-2.0; E006 + PubChem promotion rel>150 + engine-2 rank-2 + MetFrag-lite fragment gap/group gap), base cells unchanged except one marked insertion. Ours (ours_lfrag, build.py lfrag=1): the base's frag_rescore credits a peak 1.0 (precursor / 1-bond cut) or 0.6 (2-bond cut) whatever hydrogen shift it needs; we learn the credits per bucket (cut level x hydrogen shift of the cheapest explanation, linear and sqrt intensity) with a listwise softmax over 20 same-formula train isomers, fitted on 4,432 train molecules (3,000 enveda-180 + 1,432 other libraries). Held out: enveda-180 500 molecules MRR 0.723 -> 0.748, np-examples 171 molecules 0.567 -> 0.584. The learned score replaces frag_rescore everywhere the base uses it (molecules and same-formula groups no forward model scored). Hypothesis: LB > 0.451 (bronze 0.446).
